Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. While the search query explicitly included "Amy Poehler 2003 2016" and the visible results clearly showed a People.com article titled "Amy Poehler and Will Arnett's Relationship Timeline" confirming their marriage dates, the agent hallucinated a conflicting fact from an "infobox" claiming Will Arnett's spouse was "Alessandra Brawn (2019–present)". This information was not visible in the provided text or screenshot (which showed search results and a timeline article, not a Wikipedia-style infobox with that specific error), and the agent incorrectly prioritized this hallucinated/incorrect snippet over the clear, authoritative text from People.com visible in the same result set. This led to the propagation of false information regarding his spouse.
